items.title: Introducing resource context for firewall policies with AWS Transit Gateway
items.summary: AWS Transit Gateway now shares AWS resource context (VPCs, subnets, security groups, and attachments) with third-party firewalls, so you can write firewall policies based on how resources are organized instead of IP addresses. This post shows how to create a Gateway Load Balancer network function attachment and turn on context sharing.
items.creator: Rajat Tyagi

items.title: Connect business units with AWS Cloud WAN and Amazon VPC Lattice
items.summary: Enterprises connecting workloads across subsidiaries, divisions, and acquired business units face overlapping IP ranges, firewall rule sprawl, and tightly coupled routing. This post explains how AWS Cloud WAN and Amazon VPC Lattice work together, and presents three design patterns for different operational models.
items.creator: Marta Barriendos Fortuño
